## Description

Manage Docker Scout cache and temporary files






## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`docker scout cache df`](/reference/cli/docker/scout/cache/df/) | Show Docker Scout disk usage |
| [`docker scout cache prune`](/reference/cli/docker/scout/cache/prune/) | Remove temporary or cached data |
